BNB.summary: The 37th quarterly burn (about 1.65M BNB) was reported Oct 19, so that catalyst has passed. Price at 727 is still below the 738.7 long level, and ~$750 is the level the market is watching. BNB has no vesting unlocks.

SKR.summary: A 100M SKR unlock lands tomorrow, Oct 21 (1% of total supply; roughly 1.4% of circulating using the source's circulating figure), while price sits just under the 0.01456 long level. The Ledger Atom partnership is the main positive item.

TRX.summary: Tron Inc.'s $200M at-the-market share sale to buy TRX supports the long near 0.332, but TRX supply keeps growing on net every day. No unlocks.

ATOM.summary: News is bank-tokenization adoption (Wells Fargo consortium on Cosmos ledger tech, Jack Henry tokenized deposits) rather than anything hitting supply. No unlocks; Stride stATOM redemptions resume around Nov 20.
